_comment: IBM Bob hooks configuration. Copy into ~/.bob/settings/settings.json (global) or .bob/settings.json (workspace).
_comment_2: Generate this with: otel-hook setup --agent bob [--no-global]
_comment_3: Bob supports exactly five lifecycle hooks and accepts `matcher` only on PreToolUse/PostToolUse.
_comment_4: timeout is 30s rather than Bob's 10s default: a cold Python start plus an OTLP flush can exceed 10s, and Bob only logs a timeout, so a short value drops telemetry silently.
